notes.title: 2025.1.18 - DRLG Enemy Spawning Revamp, Report Feedback Panel, Lightning Rod
notes.content:
- Completely revamped how enemies spawn on missions for a more action-packed gameplay
- New Mod + Ability! The "Lightning Rod"
- Brand new Infested Airlocks, with creep hearts that must be destroyed to pass through.
- The world blurs when the escape menu is open
- Created a "Report Feedback" UI panel that submits feedback directly to the devs
- Void Enemy Improvement - Drawing Lines to buffed enemies, Prefer Ceiling Movement, Better Rotation/Shooting at player
- Sprite Texture Atlas for optimized UI elements
- Infested-Webs now show up in the creep
- Better Scarab Animations
- Dojo Panel can now spawn loot!
- Unity AI Navigation Upgrade
- We are now streaming textures for better performance
- The mist is no longer reactive to light to improve performance
- Asteroid mesh optimization and material + texture
- Fixed a bug causing the creep system to generate during the HomeShip scene
- The game is now using the latest Unity Editor version, Unity 6!

notes.title: 2024.6.22 - New Enemies, Abilities, and Side Quests. Working Tech Tree + More!
notes.content:
- Added Elemental Field and Doggo Abilities
- Added Brain and Leech Swarm Enemies. 
- Most of the Mech Bay, Robot Hub, Cargo Bay, and Assembler Tech Tree nodes are now fully functional.

notes.title: v2024.3.7a - Large Hangar Filler Objects, Flashover Ability, Recall All Drones
notes.content:
[b]New Stuff[/b]
- New Large Cosmetic Filler Objects now spawn in the Hangar
- Added a new "Flashover" Mod + Ability. Releases a 5m burst of 200% FIRE damage from the mech every 10 seconds. Increases the damage by 20% and radius by 5m per tier of FIRE.
- Recall All Drones by holding "T" for 7 seconds. It has a 30 second cooldown

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- The Broodmother no longer disappears after being killed.

[*] Big update that upgrades the project to the latest Unity 2022 LTS version (we were on Unity 2021 LTS)

notes.title: Alpha 2023.1.2 - New "Drills" Enemy and Extractor
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New Enemy: "Drills" | The Swarm has many ways of infecting a ship, but nothing is more terrifying than the Drills. No radar can detect them and no armor can dissuade them. The only warning you have is the screeching of metal as they slam through your hull. By then, it’s too late. The Drills deliver their deadly payload in a brutally efficient manner.
[*] New "Extractor" and "Extractor Point" assets for the extraction mission. More to come...
[*] The Helm and Assembler AI are now textured.
[*] Omen texture polishing and shader optimization.
[*] Added support for a new "Dissolve" VFX for the Omen.
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha 2022.30 - Omen 2.0, Mech HUD 2.0, and 3 new mods!
notes.content:
[h1]Alpha 2022.30 - Changelog[/h1]
- Absolutely massive update to our player's first home ship "Omen"
- Updated the Mech HUD so we can scale and support a lot more abilities.
- Added "Calcifer" mod
- Added "Relativity Mechanics" mod
- Added "Flash Freeze" mod
- Added smart hotkey assignments for abilities. 123456QER6T7890 is now the default order, but players can bind custom hotkeys to override.
- Rework mod attribute rolls to reflect the new ruleset.
